text:
James Rivera: Quick heads-up — Zephyr accepted an early-adopter seat for our inference delivery. Need to lock enablement dates and a lightweight feedback cadence. They want technical onboarding next week.

Priya Nair: Great, thanks James. Tue/Wed mornings PST work for us. Primary contacts: me and Raj (dev lead).

Lena Ortiz: I can run the runtime workshop + KV cache demo. @Matt Chen can you prepare the quantization checklist and a short perf runbook?

Matt Chen: Yep — will prep checklist. Putting a doc stub here: https://redwood-internal/zephyr/onboard (will populate). Also will add a cost dashboard template.

Ana Wu: FYI commercial note — this is a 6-week trial with renewal conversation expected near the end. I'll own renewal outreach, but recommend a 4-week health checkpoint to catch any risk early.

James Rivera: Agreed. Proposal: weekly sync for first 4 weeks, then biweekly. In-app survey after week 1 and week 4 to capture qualitative feedback. Also tracking KPIs: p95 latency <120ms, sustained throughput target 50 req/s, cost target <$0.35 per 1k tokens.

Priya Nair: Survey sounds good. Can the survey be <6 questions? We want something our product team will read.

Lena Ortiz: Will build a concise prompt/eval set and wire traces. Sharing the trace config we'll use for the workshop:

```
tracing:
  enable: true
  sampling_rate: 0.2
  capture: [latency_ms, model_variant, token_count]
  export_to: redwood-observability/zephyr
```

Matt Chen: I'll hook those fields into the dashboard and add an alert: cost per 1k tokens > $0.45 -> paging to #billing (low priority) and a slack DM to @Ana Wu.

DevOps Bot: Deployment started: infra/provision/zephyr-early-2026 — status: OK :white_check_mark: (provision ID: prov-zu-8912).

product-ops: Quick ask — can we capture a single customer story metric for Zephyr (e.g., latency drop %, cost delta) to feature in the mid-trial check?

James Rivera: Good call. Let's capture p95 and cost delta vs their previous on-prem baseline. Priya — can you share their baseline numbers before the kickoff?

Priya Nair: Baseline p95 ~260ms, cost is messy but ballpark $1.10 per 1k tokens.

Ana Wu: Flagging a renewal watch item: if usage <10% of expected after 3 weeks, escalate to AMs. I'll create that as a checklist item in the CRM.

James Rivera: I'll send invites for: kickoff + runtime workshop (90m), follow-up weekly syncs, and a 4-week health review. Draft agenda: 15m intros, 40m runtime deep-dive (quant + caching), 20m integration touchpoints, 15m next steps.

Priya Nair: Perfect. Can we get slides or pre-reads 24 hours before?

Lena Ortiz: Will share slides + a tiny runbook 24h before.

Matt Chen: I'll share the dashboard link and a short playbook snippet after infra is fully provisioned.

James Rivera: Thanks everyone :pray: — assigning owners: Technical success: James & Lena, Commercial/renewal: Ana, Dashboards/ops: Matt, Feedback ops & survey: product-ops. I'll follow up with calendar invites and the invite pack.

Priya Nair: Appreciate it. Looking forward to kickoff. :thumbsup:
